notes.title: 📢 Series of Events - Overhaul Begins! New
notes.content:
[p]Work has officially begun on the [i]Series of Events[/i] overhaul — and while progress has been a little slower than my usual pace, because my attention is on "Forced" things are shaping up nicely. Here’s what’s already in the works:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/3d0ec8c44772e532e0ea416370f8a5f44e981ffc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]✨ [b]95 new renders[/b] 🖼️ [b]A new main title image[/b]
🧭 [b]Updated UI[/b] – sleeker and easier to navigate
📖 [b]A reworked introduction[/b] to help better guide the split between the branching stories

Here are some of the new images, I'll not put the originals here, some of you might already still have them but I might include them in the first official drop of the game though, as a comparison. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/6f9a689bda4250e9d499bf486fdcbb76d23766c8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/a004cc308b95848ddabd28e15f180ac622d4dbc2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/5645c1896c9c585b54e6e3b2d7d4f82a1afe23d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Series of Events: A Visual Overhaul Begins! 🚨
notes.content:
🚨 Series of Events: A Visual Overhaul Begins! 🚨

Hey everyone! 🌟

The journey to overhaul Series of Events has officially started, and I'm going to share the first example of the changes coming your way! The original image vs. the new one... what a difference!
Original
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/6c0b0a097f707223c3f64bdb9088b7e9693ed361.jpg[/img]

New
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/3139c14b13786d4ebbc9b67f5eb086fd760b5166.jpg[/img]

As you can see, the updated visual provides a better view and the updated Jessica is also considerably better. I’m not gonna lie—it’s going to be a long road to update everything, over 5000 renders, but the results so far speak for themselves. 

Original
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/48c3aaa846ae663e06595d41cbd289b96d1ab98a.jpg[/img]

New
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/4423ac6f8b66d67f94206828bdc0610378b70eb9.jpg[/img]

This is just the beginning, but I’m super excited to keep improving the game piece by piece. Stay tuned for more updates as the overhaul progresses!

notes.title: Release status
notes.content:
Hello all, 

So the Series of Events release is going to take a little longer than originally anticipated. This is due to the way that I'll need to deliver the game in it's early access, which in truth won't feel very early access when it's done as I am required to complete the initial five starting points and then release via DLC (Which will be free, but I'll come onto that below)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/d02535fa7062e9eb28c4370d2a0df6816cbad970.jpg[/img]

So, in order to release the game at all, I need to first finish the five starting points which is around 23 separate stories where you will see, depending on your choices - Jessica taking a job with an adult film studio, getting a massage after training with her PT and deciding to go further or not, taking a job at the local pizza place, visiting her doctors, being tangled up in a mess of revenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/482a401a0027a75a07f2ce96cc38d22bc3519aac.jpg[/img]

So DLC, DLC will be free for this game which will have the next choices available for you to choose from, once they have been reviewed and approved for release. 

Now that I have figured this out and providing some details about everything that is important to the game, I'll be sure to update this page and announcements on news and events that directly effect the release.

Thank you,
DoAdventures
